source: Uploaded by the owner to litlfred/ihris main, commit 2e24ff22fc2687b40e8cb7491beb32dc62e95bc7 (uploads/moodle-ihris_admin.zip), 2026-10-09
title: iHRIS Administrator - Level I (Moodle course backup)
what: A Moodle 1.9.9 course backup (moodle.xml + course_files/) of the e-learning course 'iHRIS Administrator - Level I' (shortname 'iHRIS Admin 1'), from http://www.hrhresourcecenter.org/elearning, backed up 2012-08-12. Users none, user info false: no people, no posts.
_expect_comment: Established by inspection before the ingester was written (sections, modules, modules by type), and by listing the zip (regular files, including moodle.xml, and their uncompressed bytes). src/tools/ingest_moodle_course.py refuses when what it parses disagrees, and QA (moodle-course) checks library/ihris-admin-course/course.json against these numbers.
licenceNote: The backup itself states no licence: not in moodle.xml (course summary, course overview page, lesson pages, section summaries), not in the six transcripts, not in the audio or image file headers (checked 2026-10-09). Its author, the folio owner, stated on 2026-10-09 that it is under CC BY 4.0, attributed to IntraHealth International (see library/ihris-admin-course/ihris-admin-course.json). The slide audio is inventoried but not committed, for its size; the transcripts' text is extracted to Markdown and the .doc files stay here.
why_not_committed: Uploaded documents stay in uploads/, git-ignored (*.zip); this manifest pins the copy. src/tools/ingest_moodle_course.py re-checks md5, sha256 and size before deriving library/ihris-admin-course/ from it.
